caveat: Measured from CARR's own annotations (CC BY 4.0, doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.29470079.v3) -- no model inference. Frames are independent samples from a single tilted camera per store, so this is an engagement MIX, not a conversion funnel, and positions are normalised camera-frame coordinates, not floor metres. Class volumes reflect how the dataset was collected, not how often each behaviour happens in a real shop.
insight: Customers handling stock appear larger in frame than those simply passing — they physically step closer in. Aisle width and rack depth matter: people need room to move in before they will pick something up.
